label: GreedFall sandboxes
description: How GreedFall sandboxes deploy, and how to find the game on this machine. Paths: vortex.

notes: The game reads loose overrides from datalocal. A mod's files must be newer than the shipped data to win; the deploy touches their timestamps in some managers, and this app does not.
Hard links are the default: the game folder and the staging folder are almost always on one drive, and nothing is copied twice when two sandboxes share a mod.
